name: @qf-jarvis/aarohi-agent
description: QF Jarvis Aarohi AVG-1..AVG-5 offline DOMAIN (ADR-0085/0111/0112/0113/0122, QVGE overlay). The Jarvis-side domain contract for genuinely net-new, UNREGISTERED vendor acquisition: an opaque prospect identity that is explicitly NOT a Core vendor identity, a closed acquisition-case lifecycle describing Aarohi's own work rather than the party's business state, a fail-closed existing-vendor gate whose permitted set is exactly one Core status, and the ACTIVE handoff BOUNDARY that trusts QuickFurno Core alone. AVG-5 adds an offline Instagram conversation domain: inbound messages are bounded, normalized, never-interpreted OBSERVATIONS stamped INJECTED_OFFLINE_INSTAGRAM_OBSERVATION; the conversation snapshot is immutable, finite, deduplicated and canonically ordered with no outbound turn direction; and an outbound CANDIDATE is derived only from a canonical AVG-4 OPEN draft after the current Core gate is re-run, stating as literal falsehoods that no communication request, approval request, approval decision, communication authorization or execution intent was created and that nothing was sent or delivered. The Instagram token is Aarohi-local; the shared governed channel vocabulary is unchanged and still excludes Instagram, because adopting an executable Instagram channel belongs to the later QFJ-P09 execution integration. Aarohi's runtime remains PLANNED / DISABLED: no runtime, no outreach, no channel, no credential, no provider, no n8n, no Meta API, no Instagram transport, no WhatsApp, no persistence, no Core mutation and no execution of any kind. QuickFurno Core stays authoritative for registration, active/inactive/dormant/former status, previous-contact, duplicate and do-not-contact truth, vendor identity, paid/ACTIVE conversion and commercial truth; none of it may be inferred from model output, conversation text, a provider receipt, a delivery, memory, RAG or campaign state, and absent or ambiguous Core truth is a stop. Pure contracts and pure functions over frozen values. Depends on zod.
